test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct sentence where the homonym "seal" means a sea animal.

options.text: He put his official seal on the agreement.
The lawyer broke the wax seal on the letter.
We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"seal"** has multiple meanings, making it a homonym (a word that is spelled and pronounced the same but has different meanings). • **Meaning 1:** A sea animal that lives in water and on land, known for its playful nature. (समुद्री जीव) • **Example:** We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo. • **Meaning 2:** A stamp or device used to close something or show authentication. (महर या सील) • **Example:** He put his official seal on the agreement. • The correct word "seal" in this context refers to the sea animal, as described in Option 3. (समुद्री जीव) • **Example:** Seals are often seen performing tricks in aquariums. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: He put his official seal on the agreement.** (उसने समझौते पर अपनी आधिकारिक मुहर लगाई।) • **Explanation:** Here, "seal" refers to a stamp or mark used for authentication. This does not refer to the sea animal. • **Example:** The document was stamped with an official seal. • **Option 2: The lawyer broke the wax seal on the letter.** (वकील ने पत्र पर लगी मोम की मुहर तोड़ी।) • **Explanation:** In this case, "seal" refers to the wax used to close the letter. It is not related to the sea animal. • **Example:** The wax seal was carefully removed to read the letter. • **Option 4: Please seal the envelope properly.** (कृपया लिफाफे को सही से बंद करें।) • **Explanation:** Here, "seal" means to close something securely. This is also not related to the sea animal. • **Example:** Make sure to seal the package before shipping it. 1c1:T942, The correct answer is: **2) Occasional**.
